Container.Name: d2idle
Container.Overview: D.idle: idle bot for classic Diablo II LoD 1.14d under Wine (offline, single player). Web UI = setup wizard and fleet dashboard; the token is in /data/token.
Container.Requires: Built locally (image d2idle:dev, loaded from the worker), so the NAS "check for updates" shows "not available". The game files in /src are the user's own install, mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Game install (read-only)
Config.Description: Your own Diablo II LoD 1.14d install folder

Config.Name: D2FLEET_MAX_LOAD_FACTOR
Config.Description: -1 = ignore host load (the container sees the host's load average)

Config.Name: D2FLEET_SOAK
Config.Description: 1 = judge every slot with the m24 soak profile (docs/nas-container.md)
